timestamp.description: The timestamp string to guess if --guess is enabled. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.f

convert_date.description: Convert a specific date/time string to all supported timestamp formats. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.f. Empty string disables this option.

active_value.description: Active Directory 8-byte hex value to convert.

apache_value.description: Apache Cookie hex value to convert.
